correctness.rationale: The primary Jacobi wavelet kernel gives f_alpha(u)=(1-u)^(alpha+1)(1-(alpha+2)u)^2. The exact hyperbolic Jacobian gives total mass 4pi/alpha and cumulative normalized energy J_alpha. Direct derivative factorization proves two strict lobes and one secondary peak; the threshold-level bathtub comparison proves the unique global optimum among all measurable fractional masks. A nondegenerate Taylor expansion at the outer peak and an inverse-function expansion at the disk boundary give sharp birth constants and a C1 but non-C2 optimal value. Uniform rescaled root convergence proves both weight limits. check.py passed 104 finite assertions across four weights, six budgets, and near-threshold asymptotics; the proof, not finite tests, supports infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: The first excited Laguerre wavelet is the simplest natural hyperbolic coherent state with a nodal circle. Its full optimal time-scale observation-mask classification identifies a unique disk-to-disk-plus-annulus topology transition, exact captured fraction and parameter dependence, a genuine non-C2 curvature discontinuity, and two different sharp geometric growth rates. These constants are meaningful for resource-limited wavelet observation and distinguish excited and analytic windows; the result is not merely a normalization check or an arbitrary finite slice.
